rounding_rules.ag_residual_px_3dp: Ag(111) conditional pair-distance residuals are shown to 3 decimal places with method-specific n.
rounding_rules.diagram_labels: Diagram labels and exact counts are not converted into rounded estimates.
rounding_rules.endpoint_pp_6dp: Cu(111) endpoint deviations and pair-invariance percentage-point values are shown to 6 decimal places.
rounding_rules.exact_counts: Counts and denominators are shown as exact integers in numerator/denominator form.
rounding_rules.full_precision_si: Machine-readable SI retains full source precision; any reader-facing summaries declare their formatting locally.
rounding_rules.rates_2dp: Rates derived from exact counts are shown to 2 decimal places.
rounding_rules.translation_px_4dp: Controlled-translation displacement errors are shown to 4 decimal places.

missing_value_rendering: Missing or rejected measurements remain absent and are never interpolated or connected across gaps; fixed denominators retain every predefined opportunity.

items.title: Measurement chain and evidence ladder
items.role: Defines native proposal, shared Gaussian refinement, pairwise observable, and the evidence ladder before quantitative comparisons.
items.denominator_policy: Conceptual display; downstream fixed and conditional denominators are defined in Tables 1 and S2.
items.palette_policy: Native-output geometries use semantic encodings rather than a performance rank.
items.missing_value_policy: Unavailable native outputs are represented as unavailable, not imputed.

items.title: Controlled estimator behavior
items.role: Shows controlled translation paths, proposal-to-measurement behavior, measurement coverage, and pair invariance.
items.denominator_policy: Initialization states are separated from 80 displaced-spot and 40 displaced-pair evaluation opportunities per method.
items.palette_policy: Uses the frozen five-method colorblind-safe palette.
items.missing_value_policy: Rejected or unavailable measurements remain gaps and coverage is reported first.

items.title: Independent Ag(111) energy-scan stress test
items.role: Reports branch-consistent coverage, post-gap branch-consistent recovery, geometry inconsistency, and conditional residual in denominator-first order.
items.denominator_policy: Uses 221 visible opportunities, 24 evaluable gaps, accepted-fit denominators, and method-specific residual n.
items.palette_policy: Uses the frozen five-method colorblind-safe palette.
items.missing_value_policy: Visibility gaps and rejected measurements are shown explicitly and are not connected.

items.title: Controlled SAM2-family continuity–consistency trade-off
items.role: Provides a matched-weight, one-series mechanism comparison without extending it to a general strategy ranking.
items.denominator_policy: Coverage and post-gap branch-consistent recovery keep fixed opportunities; residuals retain method- and pair-specific conditional n.
items.palette_policy: Uses frozen family-specific colors without a rank-like scale.
items.missing_value_policy: Visibility gaps and invalid fits remain absent and contribute to fixed-denominator outcomes.

items.title: Common Gaussian refinement preserves the Cu(111) pairwise relative spot-radius endpoint across proposal strategies
items.role: Propagates the common measurement contract to the descriptive Cu(111) pairwise endpoint and between-method spread.
items.denominator_policy: Each method retains 2804/2804 Gaussian measurements and 701/701 endpoints for each primary pair.
items.palette_policy: Uses the frozen five-method colorblind-safe palette.
items.missing_value_policy: Missing endpoints would remain missing; no gaps are present for the two primary pairs.

items.title: Data and evidence roles
items.role: Defines data regimes, opportunity sets, evidence roles, observables, and independence units.
items.denominator_policy: Lists complete opportunity sets and separates initialization states from displacement evaluations.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable to a semantic table.
items.missing_value_policy: Unavailable elements are described explicitly in the evidence-role contract.

items.title: Methods mapped to the common measurement contract
items.role: Maps each method's native output and adapter into the shared estimator, availability, reset, and study-role contract.
items.denominator_policy: Declares availability and reset rules that determine fixed opportunity outcomes downstream.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable to a semantic table.
items.missing_value_policy: Unavailable native outputs remain unavailable under the common contract.

items.title: Controlled-translation detail
items.role: Provides full per-trial paths, proposal-to-measurement diagnostics, and pair invariance.
items.denominator_policy: Preserves 20 displaced-spot and 10 displaced-pair opportunities per trial and method.
items.palette_policy: Uses the frozen five-method palette plus a distinct oracle control.
items.missing_value_policy: Missing proposals and measurements are shown as gaps without path interpolation.

items.title: Measurement-window and capture-contract sensitivity
items.role: Shows the predefined ROI/gate matrix, OFAT perturbations, gate margins, and the width-trigger decision.
items.denominator_policy: Every variant retains 221 visible opportunities, 24 gaps, accepted-fit n, and method-specific pair-frame n.
items.palette_policy: Uses the frozen method palette and gate-specific sensitivity normalizers.
items.missing_value_policy: Undefined conditional metrics remain missing and are not promoted to fixed-denominator outcomes.

items.title: Pair-midpoint drift and apparatus/projection diagnostics
items.role: Separates midpoint drift and apparatus/projection diagnostics from the main pair-distance stress test.
items.denominator_policy: Uses only jointly valid pair frames and retains case-specific visibility branches.
items.palette_policy: Method palette is intentionally not used for apparatus/projection diagnostics.
items.missing_value_policy: Missing pairs are not interpolated or connected.

items.title: EasyLEED–ViPErLEED compatibility
items.role: Provides the separate external-reference compatibility contract and its own denominator.
items.denominator_policy: External-reference opportunities remain separate from the common five-method matrix.
items.palette_policy: Uses distinct external-reference encodings, not a sixth common-matrix method color.
items.missing_value_policy: Unavailable common fits remain absent from compatibility statistics.

items.title: Geometry-inconsistent continuation examples
items.role: Shows qualitative examples selected by a frozen rule and linked to their source rows.
items.denominator_policy: Qualitative examples remain attached to the accepted-fit denominators reported in Figure 4 and Table S2.
items.palette_policy: Example annotations identify methods without implying a rank.
items.missing_value_policy: The selected examples preserve the original missing and accepted-fit state.

items.title: Cu pair 2–4 missingness diagnostic
items.role: Keeps the pair 2-4 amplitude-driven missingness diagnostic outside the main five-method endpoint contract.
items.denominator_policy: Uses its separate 24-candidate diagnostic denominator and is not pooled into the primary pairs.
items.palette_policy: Uses the frozen method palette only for proposals inside the diagnostic.
items.missing_value_policy: Amplitude-only rejections remain explicit missing measurements.

items.title: Software, models, versions, hashes and environments
items.role: Freezes software, model, configuration, checkpoint, and environment provenance.
items.denominator_policy: Not a numerical-outcome table; provenance records are complete by declared environment role.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable.
items.missing_value_policy: Unfrozen run-time fields are labeled by provenance status rather than inferred.

items.title: Gaussian gates, fixed opportunity sets and conditional denominators
items.role: Centralizes Gaussian gates, fixed opportunity sets, and every method-specific conditional denominator.
items.denominator_policy: Every fixed outcome and conditional metric has an explicit unit, denominator, and surviving n.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable.
items.missing_value_policy: Unavailable proposals and rejected fits remain inside fixed denominators.

items.title: Ag(111) outcomes by scan–pair and leave-one-case-out
items.role: Reports scan-pair strata and leave-one-case-out sensitivity without treating four cases as independent acquisitions.
items.denominator_policy: Coverage, post-gap branch-consistent recovery, accepted fits, and pair residuals retain their own case- and method-specific denominators.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable.
items.missing_value_policy: Conditional residuals are omitted where no jointly branch-consistent pair frame survives.

items.title: Cu(111) pairwise physical endpoints
items.role: Provides full-precision pairwise endpoints at frozen thermal-cycle landmarks.
items.denominator_policy: Every method-pair endpoint reports valid frames out of 701.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable.
items.missing_value_policy: A missing endpoint would remain blank with its valid-frame count.

items.title: Controlled translations by source trial
items.role: Retains full per-trial translation coverage, conditional errors, and pair invariance including the oracle control.
items.denominator_policy: Each trial and method keeps 20 displaced-spot and 10 displaced-pair opportunities; conditional n is attached.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable.
items.missing_value_policy: Proposal and fit failures remain in the fixed denominators.

items.title: Measurement-window and capture-contract sensitivity
items.role: Reports all predefined sensitivity variants at full source precision without selecting a replacement configuration.
items.denominator_policy: Every variant retains fixed 221 and 24 opportunities plus accepted-fit and pair-frame conditional n.
items.palette_policy: Not applicable.
items.missing_value_policy: Undefined conditional values remain absent and are never converted to zero.

items.title: Cross-regime numerical summary
items.role: Places the five-method numerical anchors side by side while preserving regime-specific evidence roles and denominators.
items.denominator_policy: Each block retains its fixed opportunity set; every conditional error or residual follows coverage and carries its own n.
items.palette_policy: No color scale, composite score, or rank is used.
items.missing_value_policy: Coverage exposes missing proposals and fits before conditional values.
